summary: Registers takeWhile as a filter-like method in the Java Stream, RxJava Observable, and Reactor Flux nullability propagator models.

tests.evidence: Behavior change (new stream-model entries for three libraries) with no test added in initial or final; codecov 'covered' only reflects builder calls executed at startup, so nothing pins that takeWhile propagates predicate facts.

user_docs.evidence: No option or documented behavior changes; stream models are internal.

doc_comments.evidence: Only builder entries added under existing comments ('methods that behave like .filter'), which still hold.

change_description.evidence: Short description gives the why; NullAway changelog is written at release time by the maintainer.

performance.evidence: Three extra signature registrations; no hot-path change.

backward_compat.evidence: Only removes false positives after takeWhile; no API change.

correctness.evidence: takeWhile emits only elements for which the predicate held, so filter semantics apply; signatures in StreamNullabilityPropagatorFactory match the three libraries' APIs.

user_value.evidence: Small, obviously useful extension of an existing model.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Fewer warnings after takeWhile, consistent with filter; nothing unexpected.

contradictions.evidence: Consistent with neighbouring filter entries and comments.

spec_conformance.evidence: No external spec involved beyond library method semantics.

plan.why: Three-line model extension; only the missing test needs attention.
